title: Engineering Firm Website
tagline: Laravel 9 CMS-like site with admin and SEO metadata
intro: First freelance + university project: a Laravel site with admin panel for projects and users.
summary: Laravel 9 + Bootstrap with MySQL (Eloquent). Features admin modules, role-based auth, responsive UI, and dynamic SEO meta generation. Deployed via local/demo hosting from GitHub repos.
features: Admin panel for project & user management
SEO meta tags generated from admin data

sections.title: Description
sections.body: A company site with a Laravel-powered admin panel that manages projects and users, blending academic and freelance work.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a professional public presence with internal content and role management.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Built Laravel backend with Eloquent, developed Bootstrap UI, implemented auth/roles, and added dynamic SEO metadata.

sections.title: Features / Implementation
sections.body: Modular admin modules, structured MySQL schema, responsive layouts, and SEO-friendly meta generation.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Foundation for later Laravel and freelance work; demonstrated capability to deliver full-stack solutions.

sections.title: Future Plans
sections.body: Potential Laravel 10 upgrade with REST APIs and dashboards.
